verdict.rationale: OCI ships several scriptable, non-GUI surfaces suited to headless automation. The official CLI covers the Console's core functionality plus extra commands and installs on Linux, macOS and Windows. Behind it sit language SDKs, a standard HTTPS REST API with 12-month deprecation notice, and an official Terraform provider with Resource Manager state import. Token-based auth is also available as an alternative to keypairs. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline guidance or examples (e.g., non-interactive service-credential setup for pipelines), documented headless or non-interactive auth flows for runners, independent hands-on corroboration of driving OCI from CI.
